_comment: PRD §6 'Market system' — the three recommended MVP markets. `downtown_lunch` reproduces the §16 'Market definition example' field for field and value for value; the other two follow the same shape. `segmentWeights` keys must be ids in customer-segments.json and MUST sum to 1.0 within SEGMENT_WEIGHT_TOLERANCE (see loader.js); `eventPool` entries must be ids in events.json. `anchors` is the PRD §7 setup briefing's 'Nearby business/event anchors' — prose for the player, read by no system. `priceSensitivity` > 1 means this district punishes high prices more than average. PRD §6 lists Arts & Nightlife and Neighborhood Weekend as post-MVP; they are deliberately absent.

markets.name: Downtown Lunch Rush
markets.description: Office towers, transit stops, and a tightly timed weekday crowd.

markets.name: Uptown Pre-Theater
markets.description: Opera houses, galleries and a well-dressed crowd with a curtain to catch.

markets.name: Stadium District
markets.description: Sports bars, parking lots, and nine innings between one lull and one flood.
